description: TOML adapter (ADR-0049 D7): each case's `toml` and its JSON twin `json` resolve to the same `canonical` bytes and configDigest. Each reject's TOML is refused with the pinned field and reason. `hosts` are the injected HostFacts each case resolves under (home, XDG_STATE_HOME, the platform data directory, the OS); a null member is unset.

cases.name: standalone-example
cases.toml:
apiVersion = "config.leyline/v1"
kind = "DaemonConfig"

[source]
path = "~/src/my-project"

[mount]
path = "~/mnt/my-project"
# backend defaults to "nfs" on macOS; nfsPort defaults to 0 (the kernel picks a port).

cases.name: cloister-host-runtime-shape
cases.description: Empty TOML tables for a union branch ([cas.volume], [backend.microVm], [evidence.unverified]) select it with every default.

cases.name: sign-helper
cases.toml:
apiVersion = "config.leyline/v1"
kind = "SignHelperConfig"
resolveAllow = ["keychain://com.cloister/vault-kek-", "apple-password://com.cloister/kek-"]

[auth]
callerTokens = { file = "~/.config/leyline/caller-tokens" }

[signAllow.callers]
cloister = ["op://vault/item", "keychain://com.cloister/sk-"]
rosary = []

rejects.name: float
rejects.description: A TOML float has no v1 field type.

rejects.name: datetime
rejects.description: A TOML datetime has no v1 field type.

rejects.name: empty-backend-table
rejects.toml:
apiVersion = "config.leyline/v1"
kind = "ExecutionDaemonConfig"
catalog = "/c"
[cas.directory]
root = "/x"
runRoot = "/y"
[worker]
path = "/w"
[evidence.unverified]
[backend]

rejects.name: empty-evidence-table
rejects.toml:
apiVersion = "config.leyline/v1"
kind = "ExecutionDaemonConfig"
catalog = "/c"
[cas.directory]
root = "/x"
runRoot = "/y"
[worker]
path = "/w"
[evidence]

rejects.name: duplicate-key
rejects.description: TOML's own rule refuses a repeated key before mapping.

rejects.name: negative-integer
rejects.description: A negative TOML integer is out of range.
